description: Proposes rezoning 1401 11th Street West to allow six units.

chips.text: Municipal Planning Commission voted against administration's recommendation to deny rezoning.
Holiday Park residents and Community Association expressed concerns about the proposal.
Councillor Jeffries stated support for applicant
Administration and public warned of setting a precedent for ad hoc rezoning requests.
Applicant could not confirm if project would proceed without six units for financial viability.
69 of 75 residents consulted expressed concerns about increased density and parking.

description: Rezones 902-938 3rd Avenue North to corridor residential.
Aligns with Official Community Plan for corridor growth.

chips.text: No public comments received on the application to date.

description: Proposes closing a lane in Varsity View.
Transfers land to Ronald McDonald House.
New lane built east of 1119 University Drive.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer questioned large vehicle access for future development.
Families staying at Ronald McDonald House will have improved safety.
Ronald McDonald House supports relocation for family safety and amenities.
